newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX extends Henry Hub gas futures to 36 months.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX extends Henry Hub gas futures to 36 months.

text.p: New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) said Friday it will begin listing 36 consecutive months of trading in its Henry Hub natural gas futures contract as of March 25.
NYMEX also said that as of March 26 it will list long-dated additional quarterly contracts to Henry Hub gas options trading on a June/September/December/March cycle.
NYMEX currently lists 30 consecutive Henry Hub contracts, with a 36th month listed on a June/December cycle, the exchange said in a statement.
Twelve consecutive options months are currently listed with long-dated contracts originally listed 18, 24, 30 and 36 months in advance.
New long-dated contracts will be listed 15, 21, 27 and 33 months in advance, NYMEX said.
For the futures contract, the new contracts listed will be October and November, 1999, and January, February, March and April, 2000, NYMEX said.
The new options contracts will be April and September, 1998, March and September, 1999, and March, 2000.
